calls.statement: SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, calendar_year FROM dim_date ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_quarter,
  f.channel_code,
  s.region,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
  AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_quarter, f.channel_code, s.region
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year DESC, s.region, f.channel_code

SELECT 
  d.calendar_year,
  d.fiscal_year,
  COUNT(*) as null_count,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as null_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE f.channel_code IS NULL
GROUP BY d.calendar_year, d.fiscal_year
ORDER BY d.calendar_year DESC

SELECT 
  s.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  s.region,
  COUNT(*) as null_count,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as null_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
WHERE f.channel_code IS NULL
  AND f.sale_date >= '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name, s.region
ORDER BY null_sales DESC
LIMIT 15

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_quarter,
  CASE 
    WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN 'WB'
    WHEN COALESCE(f.channel_code, 'ST') = 'ST' THEN 'ST'
    ELSE f.channel_code
  END as inferred_channel,
  s.region,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
  AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3
  AND s.store_id < 1000  -- exclude any anomalies
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_quarter, inferred_channel, s.region
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year DESC, s.region, inferred_channel

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.store_id = 999 THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) as training_store_sales,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id != 999 THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) as regular_store_sales,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) as web_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
  AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year DESC

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  COALESCE(s.region, 'Web') as region_name,
  MAX(CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN SUM(f.net_amount) END) OVER (PARTITION BY s.region) as q3_fy2025_26,
  MAX(CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN SUM(f.net_amount) END) OVER (PARTITION BY s.region) as q3_fy2024_25
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
  AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3
  AND (s.store_id IN (900) OR (s.store_id < 900 AND s.region NOT IN ('Head office')))
GROUP BY region_name, s.region, d.fiscal_year
ORDER BY region_name

SELECT 
  s.region,
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_quarter,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
  AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3
  AND s.store_id < 900
  AND s.region NOT IN ('Head office')
GROUP BY s.region, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_quarter
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year DESC, s.region
